label: ChatCut visual handoff adapter
summary: Prepare disposable EPRS derivatives for an explicitly operated ChatCut visual pass and return only an untrusted picture candidate for local review.

handoffs.label: Prepare a disposable ChatCut package
handoffs.intent: Create a bounded preview, optional guide audio, and exact prompt/asset manifest without uploading or changing the EPRS source of truth.
inputs: An EPRS song workspace and a reviewed song-relative picture candidate
An optional guide/master audio, captions, thumbnail, and visual brief
outputs: A local chatcut/disposable-preview package with derived media, checksums, and handoff.json
An exact prompt and a bounded list of assets for the operator to inspect
steps: Run eprs chatcut prepare with only song-relative non-raw inputs; inspect the generated package before any remote action.
Watch the complete preview and verify that the derivative contains no private desktop, source-domain, credential, or raw-recording material.
If using ChatCut, manually authenticate and submit only the exact assets and prompt named in handoff.json.
verification: Confirm upload_performed is false and all authority flags remain false before the operator acts.
Confirm the local master, provenance, rights records, and prior renders remain unchanged.

handoffs.label: Operate the ChatCut Codex surface manually
handoffs.intent: Use ChatCut's hosted Codex/MCP surface only as a deliberate, user-operated visual editing step with a bounded disposable package.
inputs: An inspected handoff.json and its listed disposable assets
An authenticated ChatCut account and explicit approval to upload this package
outputs: An editable ChatCut timeline or visual draft
A returned export or XML/timeline handoff for local EPRS verification
steps: Use the current ChatCut Codex/MCP integration only after checking its current documentation and account scope.
Do not add the full EPRS repository, raw takes, masters, private recordings, credentials, or unlisted personal metadata.
Keep all remote edits provisional; do not let ChatCut publish, replace, or become the release source of truth.
verification: Record the exact assets, prompt, account surface, and export returned by the operator.
Run local media inspection and EPRS picture review on every returned export before release assembly.

handoffs.label: Return a ChatCut picture candidate
handoffs.intent: Bring a returned visual export back into the local EPRS review path without treating remote output as approved media.
inputs: A returned ChatCut export and its editable handoff if available
The local EPRS master, source manifest, and intended picture duration
outputs: A new song-local picture candidate with source URL/checksum and return notes
A complete local technical and creative review record
steps: Save the returned file as a new candidate; never overwrite the original preview, master, or FINAL package.
Inspect duration, dimensions, codecs, audio mapping, captions, visible text, and unexpected private content locally.
Cross the normal EPRS picture-review, release, and publication gates before any YouTube action.
verification: Confirm the candidate starts at master time zero and preserves the approved audio relationship.
Confirm provenance, rights, and privacy notes are complete and that technical checks do not imply creative approval.

preserve: EPRS masters, raw-material boundaries, provenance, rights evidence, captions, local picture review, and YouTube publishing control
A reversible local package with exact asset checksums, prompt text, and explicit remote-operation state
avoid: Uploading the full EPRS repository, raw takes, masters, credentials, private recordings, or identifiable personal source text
Silent authentication, hidden uploads, remote publication, overwriting local truth, or treating a ChatCut render as approved
